identificationModule.briefTitle: Treatment Regimens for Mifegyne and Cytotec
identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparison of the Effectiveness of Abortive Measures From the Administration of Mifegyne and Cytotec at One and Two Visits

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to test two regimens of mifegyne and cytotec for medical abortion. The investigators hypothesize that administration of both medications during one hospital visit will not compromise effectiveness.

interventions.name: mifegyne and cytotec
interventions.description: One day dosage versus two days dosage
otherNames: Comparison of one day dosing to two days dosing

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* above age 18,
* for whom Mifegyne and cytotec are indicated.

Exclusion Criteria:

* inflammation of oral cavity.
